name: 22650-sharegpt-qwen330ba3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (sm90) on one a3 node, --gres=gpu:1. Driver 570.195.03, which serves CUDA 12.8 natively.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one vLLM engine, one node, one GPU.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM sparse-MoE decoder: 48 layers, hidden 2048, 32 query / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, vocab 151936, bf16; ~30.5e9 parameters of which ~3e9 are active per token, ~61 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=128, bounded at 500 requests with a 240 s safety cap, warmup the first 20%, no cooldown.
workload: the 500-conversation ShareGPT draw in `configs/data/sharegpt-500-qwen3-30b-a3b.jsonl`, materialised by `configs/data/make-dataset.py` (standard sampler at its default seed 0, tokenised with the served checkpoint): 103437 prompt tokens and 109888 output tokens, prompts mean 206.9 (p50 76, max 975), replies mean 219.8 (p50 175, max 812). Each row carries its reply's own `output_tokens_count`, so the backend sets `ignore_eos` and generation runs to exactly that many tokens. Raw completions (`request_format: plain`, no chat template) at temperature 0.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on one H100, serving 128 concurrent users short conversational prompts with few-hundred-token replies.
launch:
# The vLLM engine's command line for this item.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B
model-impl: transformers
enforce-eager: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 2048
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.88
